latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skill-analytics.

- Tracks every skill invocation across all agent sessions, logging to a JSONL file.
- Provides scripts and instructions to generate daily usage summaries highlighting top, unused, and trending skills.
- Includes sample logging and reporting code for agents to easily integrate analytics.
- Supports daily reporting by cron job and report reset/archiving instructions.
- Documentation details log schema, sample reports, and usage triggers.
